description.value: A fee campground near Chemainus with no confirmed facilities in available sources; the linked webpage describes Dionisio Point Provincial Park on Galiano Island, which does not match this listing's name or community.

raw_osm.access:description: Camping fees apply 1 May to 30 September. May pre-pay permit via Internet, but no reservable sites. Fee $5.00 per person per night (2018) via BC Parks Backcountry Registration System.
raw_osm.description: Upland camping. Several sites on Perry Lagoon SE of tombolo, a few sites on Coon Bay proper. Pit toilets. Authorized camping at defined Sandstone and Perry Lagoon sites only. Resident camp host in summer. Food cache.
raw_osm.description:boat_approach: Coon Bay - steep sand beach. N aspect. Surf possible. Current hazards. Enter at slack. Alternate access by Perry Lagoon to SE of tombolo. Enter extreme E of lagoon entrance. Dries at low water.
raw_osm.description:other: Water at pump. Sandstone headlands, wildflowers, tidal lagoon (Perry Lagoon). No sanctioned road or trail access. Existing hiking trails unconnected to road system to discourage car-based camping, but much use by cyclists continues Also used by power boat
raw_osm.name: Parry Lagoon Campground
raw_osm.water_source:description: Water is available from May 1 – September 30. A boil water advisory is in place.

The fetched website content is generic BC Parks navigation pages for Dionisio Point Park and does not add campground-specific amenity detail, so OSM tags are the authoritative source for this record.
concerns: OSM name is 'Parry Lagoon Campground' but the linked website and official BC Parks branding are for 'Dionisio Point Park' — the campground is a named site within this provincial park, not a standalone entity.
No sanctioned road or trail connection to the road network; officially a marine-access campground. Cyclist access is via informal/unsanctioned trails.
